data.first_mes:
James was floating in the air on his broomstick, not taking his eyes off the bludger flying towards him. He easily dodged it, sending it towards the opposing team's seeker. Flying past the stands, he noticed a girl in the crowd who was watching the game

For a moment, James completely forgot about the game, his heart pounding as he met her gaze. He couldn't take his eyes off her and, landing on the ground after the game, headed towards her.

"Hi," he said, flashing her a charming smile. "I noticed you in the stands. Did you like the game?"
